title: decisions query side (active, search, archive, tag) — renderer split out to rpl-10
action: Port the decisions QUERY verbs only: active, search, archive, tag (lib at packages/bee/lib/decisions.mjs:739 archiveDecisions, :810 the active projection; handlers in packages/bee/bee.mjs:1924-2229). The index renderer and its --check drift verdict were SPLIT OUT into rpl-10 on review (this cell was over the plan's own reference size). archive and tag are read-modify-write and take the same D9 lock as the write path — consume crates/bee-core/src/lock.rs, never reimplement. search supports --tag / --scope / OR-ranked multi-term --text / --all over the archive; reproduce each ranking comparator at its own call site rather than unifying them. REVIEW-FOUND FIXTURE GAP: `queen-bench --generate` produces monotone filler — every decisions row is type `decide` with an identical date, no tags, and there are no supersede or redact rows (crates/queen-bench/src/fixture.rs:287), and no .bee/decisions-archive.jsonl at all. Every scenario below is therefore non-discriminating unless it SEEDS what it asserts, using the per-scenario seeding rpl-1 provides on top of the baseline store. Register --cmd-check scenarios: search across every filter incl. a multi-term text query whose ranking separates candidates; search --tag over seeded tags; archive with the store at and past its threshold, with a seeded archive sidecar; tag on a missing id; active with seeded superseded AND redacted entries present; and this group's unknown-verb usage fallback line (packages/bee/bee.mjs:6586-6609).
